title: Recap | Beijing AIGC Application Summit & AIGC100 Awards — 50+ Speakers, Nearly 1,000 Attendees
summary: On October 17, 2024 the AIGC Application Development Summit & AIGC100 Annual Awards closed in Beijing. 50+ AI speakers and nearly 1,000 practitioners joined keynotes, panels, workshops, interactive exhibits, a podcast marathon, and a dinner party.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Recap · October 23, 2024 · Venue: Beijing Vision Hotel · Host: Unique Capital · Think-tank: Unique Research

On October 17, 2024 the AIGC Application Development Summit & AIGC100 Annual Awards closed in Beijing. 50+ AI speakers and nearly 1,000 practitioners joined keynotes, panels, workshops, interactive exhibits, a podcast marathon, and a dinner party.

Opening data

Unique Capital founding partner Wei Wu released the 2024 Global AI Application Data Overview: through end-Sep 2024, global AIGC financing totaled ¥278.2B across 627 deals; China ~¥33.9B / 301 deals — market still expanding.

Keynotes

Qi Ruifeng (01.AI co-founder) — LLM trends & enterprise digitization: AI 2.0 productivity revolution; China must not copy the U.S. path. 01.AI’s “one horizontal + one vertical”: SOTA Yi base models’ horizontal generalization + deep SFT for vertical industries → standardized + vertical ToB solutions that enter client systems, improve ROI/GMV, and productize as cloud services.

Yao Minhua (Baidu AI Cloud channel GM) — Apps + intelligence = infinite possibility: Qianfan platform for AI-native apps, rich model services, full toolchains; cases in government, healthcare, education, logistics (village-head Copilot, medical Q&A bot); Qianfan AI Accelerator for startups.

Dr. Wang Shun (Google Cloud senior ML architect) — GenAI on Google Cloud: Vertex AI Model Garden, Agent Builder, Model Builder; Gemini 1.5 longer context + safety; YouTube analysis & multimodal streaming APIs; Imagen 3 image edit/customize.

Panels

  • AI investment consensus & temperature: Atom Capital Yang Mengtong; Meituan Longzhu Yu Hong; Inno Angel Wang Sheng; Gaocheng Guo Yuxiang; TusStar Zhou Jiecun; Xiniu Data CEO Li Jinxiang.
  • AI SaaS global product-market fit & growth: Sensors Data Sang Wenfeng; Vika Chen Peilin; Laiye Hu Yichuan; VAST Fan Siyang; Intelick Zhu He.
  • AI-driven software lifting productivity: Biyou Zhou Ze’an; Yuankong Feng Dawei; Huying Kunpeng; Jinyu Fang Xiaolei; LibAI Cao Renyi; Unique Capital Hu Xiaojing.
  • Software paradigms in the intelligent era: Micros CEO Wang Fuxing; Functor Jiang Yaokai; SourceYeah Ren Jinglei; Half Universe Yu Kaicheng; Integer Intelligence Pan Jianyi; Hanghang AI Li Mingshun.

Workshop, exhibit, podcast, and dinner formats rounded out the day. Full photo inventory (~32 images) in package.

— END —
